from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister


def make_ghz(num_qubits):
    qr = QuantumRegister(num_qubits, 'q')
    qc = QuantumCircuit(qr)
    qc.h(qr[0])
    for i in range(num_qubits - 1):
        qc.h(qr[i + 1])
        qc.cz(qr[i], qr[i + 1])
        qc.h(qr[i + 1])
    return qc

def propagate(n, angles):
